pitch: Follow the folk tale of kind Go Ne and greedy Wen Shu, practicing past irregular verbs and story purpose.
targetFormula: The bird fell from its nest, so Go Ne helped it.
topic: A New Friend folk tale, kind Go Ne, injured baby swallow, magical seed, gold coins, greedy Wen Shu, slingshot, roof repair, reconciliation

arc.discovery: Phase 1: Storybook Scroll unrolls the Korean village where two neighbors have very different hearts.
arc.workbench: Phase 2: The Vet Clinic Workbench requires teams to match past tense verbs (built, fell, grew, paid, hit, gave) and sequence story events.
arc.karaoke: Phase 3: The Storyteller Stage teleprompter prompts student teams to narrate the moral of the tale with emotional expression.

mechanics: Storybook smartboard game. Tapping correct past verbs mends the swallow's wing and makes the golden vine grow. Soft-fail plays a gentle harp flutter with a reminder of irregular verb forms.

correct: The swallow's wing is healed! +5 XP! 🕊️
A golden fruit blossomed on the vine! 🪙
softFail: Look closely: is it present or past tense? ⏳
Think about who helped the bird! 💡
Why did Go Ne ride his bicycle to the vet? 🚲
Check the story sequence once more! 📖
feedback.levelUp: The Golden Vine reaches the sky! Level Up to Royal Tale Weaver! 🌿👑

smartboard.boardActions: Pupils touch story illustration tiles, drag golden coins to pay the vet, and order chronological timeline cards.
smartboard.classParticipation: Pupils signal Thumbs Up (Kindness) or Thumbs Down (Greed) as story choices appear.
smartboard.version15min: 10 rounds focusing on key past tense verbs and story comprehension.
smartboard.version30min: Full 30-round championship including moral deduction, dialogue ordering, and teleprompter performance.

words.definition: A small migratory bird with a forked tail and pointed wings.
words.exampleSentence: A swallow built its nest under the roof.

words.definition: A home built by a bird using twigs and mud.
words.exampleSentence: The baby swallow fell out of the nest.

words.definition: A Y-shaped stick with an elastic band used to shoot small stones.
words.exampleSentence: Wen Shu used a slingshot to hit the bird.

words.definition: Past tense of pay: gave money for goods or medical care.
words.exampleSentence: Go Ne paid the vet with gold coins.

words.definition: An animal doctor who treats sick or injured animals.
words.exampleSentence: He rode his bicycle to the vet.

words.definition: The top covering of a building or house.
words.exampleSentence: The swallows nested under the wooden roof.

words.definition: Past tense of hit: struck something with force.
words.exampleSentence: The stone hit the swallow's wing.

words.definition: The reason an author wrote a text: to inform, entertain, or persuade.
words.exampleSentence: The author's purpose is to entertain us with a folk tale.

rounds.prompt: Who was kind to the animals in the village?
rounds.hintTurkish: Hayvanlara karşı merhametli olan komşu Go Ne idi.
rounds.audioText: Who was kind to the animals in the village?

rounds.prompt: A swallow _____ its nest under the roof.
rounds.hintTurkish: Build fiilinin geçmiş zaman hali 'built'tir.
rounds.audioText: A swallow built its nest under the roof.

rounds.prompt: One stormy day, a baby swallow _____ out of the nest.
rounds.hintTurkish: Fall fiilinin geçmiş zaman hali 'fell'dir.
rounds.audioText: One stormy day, a baby swallow fell out of the nest.

rounds.prompt: How did Go Ne take the hurt baby bird to the vet?
rounds.hintTurkish: Bisikletiyle veterinere götürdü.
rounds.audioText: How did Go Ne take the hurt baby bird to the vet?

rounds.prompt: Match present and past: PAY <---> _____
rounds.hintTurkish: Pay fiilinin düzensiz geçmiş zamanı: paid.
rounds.audioText: What is the past tense of pay?

rounds.prompt: What gift did the mother swallow bring back in the spring?
rounds.hintEnglish: A seed that grew into gold.

rounds.audioText: What gift did the mother swallow bring back in the spring?

rounds.prompt: The magical seed _____ into a tall plant with golden fruit.
rounds.hintTurkish: Grow fiilinin geçmiş zaman hali 'grew'dur.
rounds.audioText: The magical seed grew into a tall plant.

rounds.prompt: Why was Wen Shu jealous?

rounds.hintTurkish: Çünkü Go Ne zengin ve mutlu olmuştu.
rounds.audioText: Why was Wen Shu jealous?

rounds.prompt: Wen Shu used a slingshot and _____ a baby swallow.
rounds.hintEnglish: Past tense of hit stays hit.
rounds.hintTurkish: Hit fiilinin geçmiş zamanı değişmez: hit.
rounds.audioText: Wen Shu used a slingshot and hit a baby swallow.

rounds.prompt: Match: SLINGSHOT
options: A Y-shaped stick with rubber to shoot stones
rounds.answer: A Y-shaped stick with rubber to shoot stones
rounds.hintTurkish: Taş atmak için kullanılan sapan.
rounds.audioText: What is a slingshot?

rounds.prompt: What happened when Wen Shu planted his seed?
rounds.hintTurkish: Açgözlülüğü yüzünden canavarlar ve yabani otlar çıktı.

rounds.prompt: The doctor _____ Go Ne that the bird would fly again.
rounds.hintTurkish: Tell fiilinin geçmiş zaman hali 'told'dur.

rounds.prompt: How did Go Ne pay the vet for medicine?
options: With gold coins from his harvest plant

rounds.hintTurkish: Büyülü meyveden çıkan altın paralarla ödedi.

rounds.hintTurkish: Go Ne paid the vet kindly.
rounds.audioText: Go Ne paid the vet kindly.

rounds.prompt: Match present and past: GIVE <---> _____
rounds.hintTurkish: Give fiilinin geçmiş zamanı: gave.

rounds.prompt: What did Wen Shu leave at Go Ne's house after learning his lesson?

rounds.prompt: The mother bird _____ Go Ne a shiny seed.

rounds.hintTurkish: Merhametli adam yaralı kırlangıca yardım etti.
rounds.audioText: The kind man helped the injured swallow.

rounds.prompt: Match: VET

options: The bird fell from the nest.

rounds.answer: The bird fell from the nest.
rounds.hintTurkish: The bird fell from the nest.

rounds.hintTurkish: Fly fiilinin geçmiş zaman hali: flew.

rounds.prompt: Wen Shu was sorry that he _____ the little bird.
rounds.hintEnglish: Past tense of hurt stays hurt.

rounds.hintTurkish: Sonunda gerçek dost oldular.
rounds.audioText: At the end of the story, Go Ne and Wen Shu became true friends.
